construction_route: A deterministic date-fixture builder is used because V5-2 executes independent binding_offsets draws and has no executable evenly_spaced algorithm for career-wide session placement. The simulation engine is unchanged.
coverage_rule: A comparison requires HIMARS-scope records beginning at least 365 days before analysis_as_of and at least one HIMARS event day in (analysis_as_of - 365 days, analysis_as_of]. This is an analytic coverage rule, not a medical threshold.
label: SME-INFORMED FICTIONAL HIMARS SCENARIO REFERENCE — NOT CLINICAL DATA
observation_note: Windows are repeated observations of the same fictional careers, not independent subjects.
revision_note: v1 used even spacing with ±20-day jitter; it made max_events_14d constant and the reference unable to represent clustering, so pre-registered clustered/increase gates failed. v2 replaces only the placement assumption; gates and the 5th-percentile threshold are unchanged.

placement.value: k distinct days drawn uniformly within each fictional year (least-informative placement given only a per-year count)

rate_assignment.value: each career retains one endpoint rate for all six fictional years

rates.basis: source-bound endpoints of approximately 4–5 per year; not a fitted distribution

seed_derivation.value: first 8 SHA256 bytes of colon-separated seed:career:year:event; event=0 for the per-year placement draw, year=event=-1 for the career offset

unit_mapping.value: one fictional period/session equals one fictional occupational event day

source_limitations: No generalization to Army-wide, current Active Army or individual exposure frequency.
Retrospective recollection, not an official rate, population truth, prior distribution or medical exposure value.
Single retrospective account; no dates, service duration, logs, sampling frame or independent verification. Period and event may have different boundaries.
Approximate average recollection of live-fire periods; boundaries and participant coverage unverified.
Source wording is retained; this is a research activity mapping. No equivalence of sessions, rounds, days, qualifications or individual exposures is assumed.
Scope is limited to the named requirement, unit, school or exercise; no population frequency is inferred.
support level E, source_only, distribution_family none
source_wording: approximately 4–5 live-fire training periods per year
threshold_rule: prototype analytic threshold: 5th percentile of reference score_samples; not clinical, blast or injury
